verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for a project-management tool, but the evidence pack documents no rule builder or event-based triggers in Basecamp. The scheduled check-in questions are a recurring schedule, not event-triggered rules. Templates are reusable structure, not automation. The REST API, CLI and MCP support are developer building blocks someone could use to build automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
